verdict.rationale: Apple's own pages (apple-m5-docs-15) give some concrete specs — GPU/Neural-Engine core counts and 153GB/s memory bandwidth — and community benchmarks (apple-m5-comm-8, apple-m5-comm-12/13) supply independent throughput numbers, but Apple never publishes CPU/GPU clock speeds, power/TDP figures, an AI TOPS rating, or any stated test conditions/methodology; marketing language ('four times the peak GPU compute', 'faster Neural Engine') dominates instead of a full spec sheet. missing for 10: published clock speeds, power/TDP figures, an explicit AI TOPS number, and documented benchmark test conditions.
